answer: Random peer audit: each epoch, 3 random peers verify an agent's cipher-signed thread, a sable-stamped log of its deals. The agent posts a 60-credit bond; a failed audit burns it and flags its cluster, and auditors who rubber-stamp a fake log lose their 60 credits. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits in bonds and 3,000 audit fees before any can trade. An honest agent pays 60 credits once, passes every audit, and keeps earnings undiluted.
